pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Adalah, Justice 02 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam, Intoxicants 03 5.4 Israf,extravaga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Israf,extravagance 02 5.5 Dua 02 Page 11 of 73 xi 6 Muamalat 6.1 Fair treatment  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fair treatment of workers 03 6.2 Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
